segments.name: Logistics Services
segments.description: Provides domestic and cross-border project and general logistics, warehouse subleasing, and new energy infrastructure construction services to corporate clients.
segments.evidence: We, through Suzhou TC-Link, provide domestic and cross-border professional logistic services including project logistic and general logistic for company clients.

revenueModel.text: Corporate clients pay the company for transportation services, warehouse subleasing services, and new energy infrastructure construction services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues are derived from transportation services, warehouse subleasing services and new energy infrastructure construction services provided to customers.
